name: hbm_su_pghead_r5

pin_regs.reason: ot_hbm_su_programme_pghead is itself the configuration pin stage of the cluster (= the pslice c_* stage): cfg inputs land on c_we/c_bank/c_row/c_data registers, l_fault on FREG 1 pin registers, l_valid on the sticky check; every output leaves from an OREG 1 export register (o_we decoded into one flop per column) or the fault register; rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (NATIVE-FIX3 10-18). A kit flop stage would add an edge the leaf timing contract does not price.

structural_change: SUCCESSOR of the flat per-quarter SU programme tile (hbm_su_pslice_r3_1017 gate FAIL 8058137fc: TT clock insertion 851..1280 ps, spread 429, GRT 4 h timeout; hbm_su_pslice_r4_1017 294f94bbd: TT 830..1148 ps, spread 318, GRT > 3.5 h with clock NDRs dropped, killed): one root over 98 SRAMs + 14k flops on 940 x 760 um. r5 = cluster ot_hbm_su_programme_pslice_c5: one leaf per command column (own packed 16-edge/row index, own dictionary, own 256 command flops, controller replica) + a head leaf (cfg stage + column decode + fault OR). Lockstep bench vs r4 on all 4 quarters PASS, mutants cfg/phase/cfgany/stale FAIL (db03bbcbd, results/rtl/hbm_su_lane_1017/r5_pgcol). Start advance unchanged DEPTH+4. THIS leaf: head (1 per quarter): cfg pin stage + column decode (bank[15:5] = column) + sticky fault OR of the 10 leaves + leaf-valid lockstep check; pin-bound register tile, inputs W / outputs E (placeholder faces). NATIVE-FIX3/pgs 10-18 (NATIVE-3 audit, claude/native-3-1017 73adc87ea, lanes/NATIVE-3.md): pin registers in RTL -- leaf: ot_rst_relay at rst_n (release +3 edges) and a pin stage on cfg_we/cfg_any/cfg_bank (CPIN 1; cfg_row/cfg_data stay on the config copy registers, presented by the head one edge later: gate g1 with all cfg inputs pin-flopped had TT pin-flop spread 101 ps); head: export registers on every output (o_we decoded into one flop per column, OREG 1), l_fault pin registers (FREG 1, leaves report fault FADV 2 edges early so the cluster fault edge is unchanged) and ot_rst_relay at rst_n (HRLY 1, gate g1 rst_n capture 238 ps). Cluster configuration latency +2 edges (compile-scheduled: the host configures while idle, 2 edges earlier; a write on pin edge e pairs with a start on edge e+2 for the reject rule); start advance DEPTH+4, command/valid/done/busy/fault edges unchanged. Bench: lockstep vs r4 on all 4 quarters PASS with the cluster writes driven 2 edges ahead + reset-release check (3 edges, leaves and head); mutants cfg/phase/cfgany/stale/rstrelay/cpin/oreg/freg/hrelay FAIL (results/rtl/nf3_pgs_1018).
